title: Identity Service token validation failure — widespread login errors
root_cause: Certificate rotation script left expired cert in rotation pool
summary: JWT validation failed for approximately 35% of authentication requests for 47 minutes. Root cause was an expired TLS certificate left in the rotation pool by an automated rotation script that lacked expiry validation.

title: Data Pipeline ETL job backlog — analytics stale for 6 hours
root_cause: Memory leak in Spark job caused worker OOM after schema change deployment
summary: An undetected memory leak in the aggregation Spark job caused all workers to OOM-kill after a schema change. Analytics data was stale for 6 hours for all customers.

title: Notification Service SMS delivery latency — 15-minute delays
root_cause: Third-party SMS gateway rate limit hit during marketing campaign blast
summary: SMS notifications were delayed by 10–18 minutes during a customer marketing campaign. The third-party gateway applied rate limiting that our retry logic did not handle gracefully.

title: Billing Engine invoice generation failure — batch run skipped
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion caused by long-running queries from new reporting feature
summary: Monthly invoice generation batch skipped for 23 customers. Connection pool was exhausted by slow analytical queries introduced in a reporting feature deployed two days prior.

title: Search Service index corruption — zero results for all queries
root_cause: Elasticsearch shard corruption during rolling upgrade due to incompatible index mapping
summary: All search queries returned zero results for 2 hours. During a rolling Elasticsearch upgrade, an incompatible index mapping was applied mid-upgrade, corrupting one shard and triggering replication failures.

title: Payments API intermittent 500 errors — processor timeout spike
root_cause: Payment processor upstream latency spike caused cascading timeouts in connection pool
summary: Approximately 8% of payment charge requests returned 500 errors for 55 minutes. An upstream latency spike from the payment processor exhausted our connection pool, causing timeouts to cascade.

title: Customer Portal login loop — OAuth redirect misconfiguration
root_cause: OAuth redirect URI misconfiguration after domain migration
summary: Customers were caught in a redirect loop on login for 90 minutes following a domain migration. The OAuth redirect URI was not updated in the IdP configuration.

title: Payments API complete outage — processor integration failure
root_cause: Payment processor pushed a breaking API change to their /v3/charge endpoint without prior notice. Our integration library pinned to v3 had no fallback to v2.
summary: All payment charge and refund operations failed for 3 hours and 12 minutes on 2026-07-18. The payment processor silently deprecated the /v3/charge endpoint and replaced it with /v4/charge without customer notification. NovaEnterprise's integration library was pinned to v3 with no graceful fallback. Revenue impact was approximately $2.1M. Five enterprise customers escalated to executive support.

title: Analytics Dashboard blank screen — API schema version mismatch
root_cause: Frontend dashboard loaded stale cached API schema after backend deployment
summary: Analytics Dashboard rendered a blank screen for 40 minutes after a backend deployment changed the chart data schema. The frontend was loading a cached schema version from the CDN.

title: Billing Engine duplicate charge issue — idempotency key collision
root_cause: Idempotency key generation used timestamp with millisecond precision; two retries within the same millisecond produced the same key
summary: 27 customers were charged twice for monthly subscriptions during the September billing cycle. The root cause was an idempotency key collision when the Billing Engine retried failed charge requests within the same millisecond. The issue was identified by a customer complaint 4 hours after the billing run.

title: Payments API elevated error rate — network policy change
root_cause: Kubernetes network policy update blocked egress to payment processor CIDR range
summary: Approximately 22% of payment requests failed for 28 minutes after a Kubernetes network policy update accidentally blocked egress traffic to the payment processor's IP range.

title: Data Pipeline warehouse sync failure — partition table lock
root_cause: Long-running analytics query held a partition lock preventing the nightly warehouse sync
summary: The nightly warehouse sync failed due to a partition table lock held by an ad-hoc analytics query that ran for over 4 hours. Data was 18 hours stale when the issue was discovered.
